title: Razzy the Rogue
artStyle: A needle-felted wool diorama photographed like a handmade craft scene. Characters are chibi-style - small, round, simple bodies with oversized heads, cute and hand-shaped, slightly lumpy and imperfect, with visible needle-felting texture and wispy loose wool fibers around the edges. All features are made of felt: eyes are simple small felted dots or flat felt shapes (no glass, no shine, no reflections, no highlights), and mouths and other details are also simple felted shapes. Environments are simple with just a few felted objects. Earthy, muted color palette, warm moody lighting with soft shadows, shallow depth of field so the scene feels like a real physical diorama.

razzy.description: A tiny orange tabby kitten with cream muzzle and paws, rusty stripes and a long curled striped tail, wearing a muted plum hood with both ears poking through, a short brown jacket, a belt with two sheathed daggers, one pouch and a small coil of rope.

burrowes.description: Professor Burrowes, a short plump dark-brown mole with a broad rosy-brown nose, broad digging paws and pale blunt claws, wearing thick round tortoiseshell spectacles, an ochre waistcoat, oatmeal shirt and rumpled moss-brown jacket.

weasel.description: A slender male white weasel with rose-pink eyes, burgundy pupils, scheming eyebrows and a sly smirk, wearing narrow brass spectacles low on his nose, a charcoal flat cap, burgundy long coat, oatmeal shirt and charcoal trousers, with a brass key at his belt and a closed brown notebook.

ferret.description: A scrappy male black-footed ferret with cream fur, dark eye mask, black paws and feet, a dark-tipped tail and a crooked grin with one small tooth, wearing a floppy rust-red cap, frayed moss-green jacket, mustard shirt, brown trousers and one patched suspender, carrying a crumpled brown sack.

prefect.description: A tall adolescent tawny hare with long upright ears, wearing a navy academy tunic, an ochre prefect sash and a small brown belt pouch, with neat clothes and a fussy, self-important posture. He wears short dark brown trousers and plain brown ankle boots.

fieldcraft_teacher.description: A broad adult badger with charcoal-and-cream facial stripes and sturdy paws, wearing a russet work tunic with rolled sleeves and a dark brown utility apron, with a patient but brisk expression. He wears ochre-brown trousers and sturdy dark brown boots.

potions_teacher.description: A small round adult hedgehog with soft brown felt spines and a cream face, wearing a muted blue work robe and a pale apron with one old stain, with a precise, kindly expression and no spectacles.

cook.description: A broad adult white goose with an orange bill and feet, wearing a russet neckerchief, simple brown tunic with rolled sleeves and a flour-colored apron, with a brisk but warm expression.

tunnel_snakes.description: Three small olive-green snakes with cream bellies, simple rounded heads and dark beadlike eyes, depicted in handmade felt. Calm and curious, without exposed fangs. They rest in a shallow earthen recess just inside the fresh tunnel bend.

courtyard_gate.description: A warm sandstone academy courtyard with a noticeboard beside the main entrance, a loading area, a front gate in the outer wall and a treeline beyond. A side path curves toward the service yard. Dark timber and muted moss-green accents unify the handmade felt buildings.

entrance_hall.description: A warm sandstone entrance hall with a broad curved wooden staircase and continuous polished banister ending at the ground floor. A large circular dark-iron chandelier hangs above the central floor. A wall winch has a release catch and a stone counterweight in a protected recess. A kitchen door sits beneath the upper landing; the practice gallery opens at ground level.

practice_gallery.description: A long timber-floored practice gallery with windows on the left, targets on the back wall and a doorway at back right. A wheeled straw dummy has a simple hinged wooden towing handle. A thick moss-green landing mat lies beside the exercise area. The floor is plain and flat; there are no tracks or ceiling pulleys.

potions_classroom.description: A warm sandstone classroom with low wooden workbenches, deep mixing trays and shelves of a few boldly shaped jars. A water cistern feeds a rinse basin beside a broad grated overflow channel at floor level.

kitchen.description: A warm academy kitchen with pumpkin crates, a wooden preparation table, pantry door, open cellar stairs and a serving-lift shaft connecting to the upper hall. A window looks over the service yard toward the treeline. The ordinary door leads to the entrance hall beneath its landing.

burrowes_office.description: A welcoming small study with a low wooden desk, ochre lamp, fossils on a shelf, a faded archival drawing pinned to a board and an open brown spectacles case on the desk. A low storage cupboard stands against the sandstone wall. No secret opening is visible.

dormitory.description: A shared junior dormitory with low wooden beds, pegs holding expedition packs, one narrow moonlit window and Razzy's bed at the end of the row. Simple rounded felt furnishings make the room warm and lived-in.

portrait_corridor.description: An upper sandstone corridor connecting the hall landing and junior dormitory. Closed windows face a shallow recess holding a muted green-and-gold founder's tapestry. A worn rectangular hinged stone hatch with a recessed iron ring lies partly beneath the hanging hem.

access_shaft.description: A narrow old stone access shaft beneath the portrait corridor, with an open stone hatch and crumbling masonry rim overhead. A small rectangle of corridor light shines down. The chamber below remains unseen.

character_portrait.description: A plain warm beige background with Razzy alone. No other characters, scenery or extra props.

shaft_landing.description: The bottom of the old sandstone access shaft, with a sloping bank of loose sandy earth and a single low arched exit at right toward the founder’s chamber. Plain dusty ground and a narrow light opening overhead.

founders_chamber.description: A modest low vaulted sandstone workroom. A squat drafting desk stands against the back wall under a carved eight-point compass emblem, an empty document niche sits to its left, and an arched passage doorway opens at right. Sparse archival boxes on built-in shelves and a moss-green stool. Movable plans and clues are added per scene.

underground_junction.description: An old sandstone passage divides: left, an intact masonry compass arch and broad stone stairs; right, a ragged freshly dug earthen hole with exposed roots, shovel marks, irregular spoil heaps and a single rough timber support. Its dark continuation bends out of sight; no finished masonry wall at its end. A clay drain outlet remains high at the right entrance. Movable tools are added per scene.

fresh_excavation.description: A hurried irregular earth excavation with exposed roots, shovel gouges, loose spoil heaps and one rough timber support near its entrance. The tunnel continues around a dark bend; no finished wall or vault interior is visible. The clay drain sits high at the entrance. Use the current junction reference for continuity; tools are scene props.

tower_lookout.description: A small sandstone tower room with a deep-set broad arched window, low sill and folded wooden shutters. Stairs enter at left behind a low stone parapet; a plain built-in bench stands at right. The window overlooks the front lawn, iron gate between two sandstone posts, path and treeline.

burrowes_spectacles.description: A spare pair of thick round tortoiseshell spectacles with heavy clear lenses, matching Professor Burrowes's worn pair, resting in a simple open brown case. Distinct from the weasel's narrow brass spectacles.

rope_snare.description: A soft tan rope with dark red whipping at its end, arranged in a plain running loop. Its length depends on the trap; its materials and markings remain consistent.

archival_drawing.description: A small faded sepia drawing of the academy pinned to a board, showing one outlined missing room. It has no usable underground route map and is distinct from the founder's complete plans discovered later.

laundry_cart.description: A deep rounded rectangular golden-brown wicker basket with a thick rolled rim on a low dark wooden chassis and four chunky wooden wheels. Large enough to conceal Razzy. Empty in its reference; cream sheets and other contents are specified per scene.

sticky_foam_pot.description: Razzy’s round terracotta mixing pot with a carved band, wooden lid and wooden spoon. It contains pale lavender adhesive paste that has foamed up. After settling it remains sticky. Razzy takes the pot to the kitchen on a deep wooden tray to clean later; it stays beside the kitchen basin when he becomes distracted.

founders_plans.description: One large folded sheet of aged cream parchment with sparse sepia floor-plan linework, marginal mechanism sketches and a faded green eight-point compass mark at lower right. Distinct from the office elevation drawing. Reference establishes appearance only; exact route linework must be settled against the story’s navigation before a readable map close-up.

expedition_carriage.description: A sturdy dark wooden four-wheel school coach with moss-green cabin panels, a gold compass emblem, oatmeal canvas roof, side door with boarding step, facing passenger benches, front driver seat and empty rear luggage rack. Add passengers, luggage and a draft team only for scenes requiring them.

founders_notebook.description: A small worn moss-green clothbound notebook with an embossed eight-point compass, cream pages and a russet ribbon bookmark. Contains handwritten accounts and sepia sketches of building the academy, with folded cream school plans tucked inside the back cover.

meet_razzy.title: Ready for the Dig
meet_razzy.text:
Tomorrow is the Grand Archaeological Dig. Razzy has never been on a dig before, and he can hardly wait. What if he finds buried treasure?
He has everything ready. “I sure hope they choose me this time!”

below_the_noticeboard.title: Below the Noticeboard
below_the_noticeboard.text:
Razzy runs up to the prefect. Will he get to dig with the older students?
“Have they chosen the digging team yet?”
“Not yet. Training first, then kitchen duty,” says the prefect. “Fetch a rope from upstairs.”
Kitchen duty again. Razzy wanted a chance to dig. Maybe if he does well at training, the teachers will choose him.

“Mind the luggage!” the prefect calls.
There is room to squeeze past it beside the wall. Razzy could also slide down the banister, but the laundry cart is near the bottom.

“I've just folded those!” says the prefect.
“Sorry,” says Razzy. “Can you help me out?”

down_the_stairs.title: Down the Stairs
down_the_stairs.text:

“Slow down, Razzy!” calls the prefect.
“I want the first turn!” Razzy calls back, hurrying toward the lesson.

ropes_and_snares.title: Ropes and Snares
ropes_and_snares.text:
Razzy wants to show the teacher how good he is with a rope.
The prefect pulls the dummy toward his loop. “Catch the dummy,” says the teacher. “Let the prefect pass first.”
The prefect steps into the loop. The dummy is just behind him. Razzy grips the rope, eager to pull.

a_quiet_success.text:
Razzy waits until the prefect is clear. When the dummy rolls into the loop, he pulls.
“Well done!” says the teacher. “You watched and waited.”
“I caught it!” Razzy beams. The teacher saw him do it, too. Perhaps he still has a chance to join the digging team.

The loose earth breaks Razzy’s fall.
“Hello? Can anyone hear me?”
Nobody answers. He tries to steady his breathing.
The wall is crumbly, but he might be able to climb it. Or he could try the low passage. He can see a little way inside.

They’re going to rob the school.
